long_description:
Ergo is AI revenue infrastructure for B2B sales teams. It ingests every customer interaction (calls, email, Slack, calendar) and turns it into deal health scores, forecasts, ready-to-send follow-ups, rep coaching, and clean pipeline data, automatically. Reps skip the admin, deals stop slipping, and leaders get a pipeline they can actually trust.

Teams can use Ergo to consolidate and replace tools like Gong, Attention, Superhuman, Vitally, call recorders, and more. Onboarding backfills your historical calls, emails, and deal data, so you don't start from scratch.

Ergo is backed by Y Combinator and FundersClub, and trusted by sales teams at Pylon, Rho, Retell AI, Warp, Oneleet, and Whop.

Book a demo at joinergo.com.
name: Ergo
one_liner: Ergo is the context layer that helps revenue teams close more deals.
